from units.audio import midi_note, midi_hz
from units.si import Hz

schema Tone scope logical:
    id: String key
    note: midi_note mutable
    freq: Hz mutable

rule a4_is_440:
    Tone t where midi_to_hz(t.note) == 440_Hz
->
    log info "a4 is 440"

rule octave_up:
    Tone t where hz_to_midi(t.freq) == 81_midi_note
->
    log info "880 is 81"
